description.value: West Coast Wilderness Lodge is a boutique oceanfront wilderness resort in the remote village of Egmont on BC's Sunshine Coast, established in 1997 on seven acres of coastal rainforest at the confluence of four major waterways. The resort offers two accommodation streams: all-inclusive Heritage Lodge packages and year-round, self-catering Villas on the Inlet with full kitchens and private balconies. It sits at the gateway to guided kayaking, Zodiac tours to Skookumchuck Rapids and Princess Louisa Inlet, float plane excursions, and dozens of coastal rainforest hiking and biking trails.
